position: A source candidate can enter the learner path only after its reviewer, scope, decision, and boundary are visible.
headline: Review before the corpus speaks.
copy: This workflow keeps source expansion calm by making approval steps explicit before answer promotion.

postures.title: Approved for citation packet
postures.copy: Reviewer scope, source citation, rights posture, and boundary are complete.

postures.title: Needs specialist review
postures.copy: Mantra, commentary, ritual, medical, or category-sensitive cases need a named review lane.

postures.title: No answer promotion
postures.copy: No-source, rights-blocked, or high-overclaim records stay out of learner answers.

flow.title: Assign role
flow.copy: Source, mantra, commentary, or safety reviewer.

flow.title: Review source
flow.copy: Check family, citation, rights, and meaning capsule.

flow.title: Decide
flow.copy: Approve, hold, revise, block, or route to no-source.

flow.title: Audit
flow.copy: Preserve decision notes before answer promotion.

decisions.label: Reviewer role
decisions.reason: Approval without role is not review.

decisions.label: Decision note
decisions.reason: Future users need to know why the source moved.

decisions.label: Boundary text
decisions.reason: Answer cards must know what not to claim.

decisions.label: Production write
decisions.reason: This prototype stores no production approval.
